title: Hallucinations in LLMs: A Lifecycle-Based Survey of Causes, Detection, Mitigation, and Prevention
abstract: arXiv:2608.26168v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The lifecycle of hallucination in LLMs is a concept that enables building solid frameworks on the control and reliability of LLMs in high-stakes environments, including health, legal, and scientific research. Although previous surveys have primarily focused on detection or mitigation, this survey provides a lifecycle-based overview of the hallucinations in the LLMs, their cause, detection, mitigation, and prevention.We propose a three-fold categorization of hallucinations across the LLM lifecycle: data-related, training-related, and inference-related, which is consistent with the lifecycle of the development of the LLM. translated_title: 大语言模型中的幻觉：基于生命周期的原因、检测、缓解与预防综述
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26168v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）中的幻觉生命周期是一个概念，它有助于在医疗、法律和科学研究等高风险环境中建立关于LLM控制和可靠性的坚实框架。尽管以往的综述主要集中于检测或缓解，本综述提供了基于生命周期的LLM幻觉概述，涵盖其原因、检测、缓解和预防。我们提出了跨LLM生命周期的三类幻觉分类：数据相关、训练相关和推理相关，这与LLM开发的生命周期一致。每个阶段都讨论了幻觉的原因、检测方法，以及在特定缓解或预防干预下可解决的方式。此外，我们使用多个参数讨论了可用的基准数据，以确定其在识别、限制和评估幻觉方面的适用性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于生命周期的幻觉分类框架，将LLM幻觉分为数据、训练和推理三类，并系统综述了各阶段的原因、检测、缓解与预防方法，以及基准数据的评估标准。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lifecycle-based taxonomy categorizing LLM hallucinations into data-, training-, and inference-related types, and systematically reviews their causes, detection, mitigation, and prevention alongside benchmark evaluation criteria.
